obfuscation_indicators: difficult to predict future financial results
risk_summary: The excerpt presents substantial exposure to macroeconomic volatility, government budget changes, commercial aviation demand, supply-chain interruptions, customer payment delays, fixed-price contracts, and key-person dependence. While it provides some quantified revenue and margin changes, much of the risk discussion relies on broad contingencies, extensive boilerplate, and unquantified downside scenarios. Operating performance weakened in 2012, including a 7.3% revenue decline and higher cost of goods sold as a percentage of revenue.
